description: Draft a message within a transaction for the owner to send. Nothing is delivered by this tool yet: it returns the draft text and the owner's messaging setting (draft or send) so the owner can read and send it themselves.

recipient.description: The recipient principal ID, or "oscar" to send to the Oscar AI assistant. If omitted, the message is sent to all parties on the transaction.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID context for the message

name: propxchain_send_message
